title: Voice pack — one register's renderings of meaning for one project
description: The first store that re-expresses MEANING itself: learner-facing copy as a RENDERING of the atom's meaning, external and keyed, never embedded (constitution: reference, don't embed). Structurally a locale pack shifted in REGISTER instead of language — sibling family to locales/<lang>.json, same keying precedent (2026-08-25 occurrence identity): entries key on atom_id (meaning is re-expressed once per atom+register), element_overrides key on element_id only where placement constrains length or form. TWO PINS govern every entry: source_hash always pins the ATOM's content_hash (the meaning anchor — every rendering at every coordinate is gated against the atom, never transitively against another rendering), and derived_from, where present, pins the TEXT the writer worked from (for an element override, the pack's own atom-level entry). Pack instances live PER-PROJECT (cgen/<client>/projects/<proj>/voice/<register>.json); this schema and the register vocabulary live in core.

register.description: A register id from vocab/register.enum.json — governed, closed list; the validator rejects anything else. Per-register status in the vocab additionally gates authoring: accepted entries are only admitted for a `specified` register.

entries.description: atom_id → rendering. One rendering of the atom's meaning in this register.

element_overrides.description: element_id → rendering, ONLY where the occurrence's placement constrains length or form (heading vs sentence, character limits). Each override should chain from the pack's own atom-level entry via derived_from.

text.description: The rendered learner-facing copy. The words may change; the gate proves the meaning didn't.

status.description: draft = proposed by the writer (Dragoman voice mode); accepted = a human accepted it (propose→accept, the Amanuensis pattern). The agent never sets accepted — acceptance is a human write, mechanically.

reviewer.description: Who accepted. Required when status is accepted.

source_hash.description: The ATOM's content_hash at rendering time — the meaning anchor. A mismatch with the atom's current hash means the meaning moved and this rendering is stale.

derived_from.description: The text the writer worked from, when it was not the verbatim atom — e.g. an element override chaining from this pack's atom-level entry. Locale packs use the same shape to chain from an accepted voice entry (see locales/README.md). Staleness propagates down the chain: atom changes → voice stale → descendants stale.

pack.description: Store-relative path of the source pack, e.g. voice/warm_direct.json.

key.description: The source entry's key in that pack (atom_id or element_id).

hash.description: sha256 of the source entry's text at derivation time.
